01 Work Experience

Design in practice

U.S.-BASED ETSY CLIENT

Part-Time VA — T-Shirt Graphic Designer

2025 – Present

I work as a part-time Virtual Assistant and Graphic Designer for a U.S.-based client with an Etsy shop, creating designs for a variety of products, including kids’ T-shirts, adult shirts, crewnecks, and tumblers. I create and refine graphics based on client requirements, project briefs, and current market trends.

For my design workflow, I primarily use Adobe Illustrator and Kittl, including Kittl’s built-in AI design tools when required for specific projects. I use Upwork to receive and manage design tasks, Dropbox to organize and deliver final PNG files, and Printify to upload designs for print-on-demand products.

I also conduct Etsy and EverBee research to identify trending designs, popular products, and market opportunities. These trends serve as references for developing similar but original designs that align with current customer interests.

Through this role, I have gained hands-on experience in apparel and product graphic design, digital illustration, typography, print-on-demand, Etsy product research, trend analysis, task management, file organization, and remote client collaboration.

View Tough Athletics in Figma ↗
Description

A web-based gym management system developed to streamline membership, attendance, and administrative operations for Tough Athletics Gym in Malaybalay City.

The system was designed to address the challenges of manually managing memberships, payments, approvals, and attendance. It provides members with a convenient way to register, securely log in, and check in to the gym using QR codes, while giving administrators a centralized dashboard for managing memberships, monitoring attendance, sending notifications, and generating reports.

The project also incorporates secure authentication, role-based access control, JWT authentication, and OAuth login to protect user information and ensure that members and administrators have appropriate access to system features.

Overall, the system helps reduce manual administrative work, improve attendance and membership tracking, strengthen security, and provide a more convenient experience for both gym members and staff. The project also provided our team with hands-on experience in full-stack development, API integration, authentication, QR code systems, and modular web application design.

Description

VegieCraft is a community-focused online marketplace designed to connect local farmers, artisans, and consumers in Malaybalay City and nearby rural communities. The platform provides a convenient way for people to discover and purchase locally sourced products such as fresh vegetables, organic produce, handmade crafts, and indigenous artworks.

The project was created to help local sellers reach more customers and increase their income by giving them a digital space to showcase and sell their products. At the same time, consumers can easily access a variety of locally made and locally grown products without having to rely solely on traditional marketplaces.

As a prototype, VegieCraft focuses on visualizing how the platform would work and how users would interact with it. The prototyping process helped identify potential design issues, improve functionality, and create a more user-friendly shopping experience before full development.

Overall, VegieCraft aims to support local businesses, promote locally sourced products, and strengthen the local economy through e-commerce.

My contribution
System Figma Designer & System Documenter
Figma prototype
View Yoona in Figma ↗
Description

A product display and inventory management website designed for a local computer and IT services business. The system was created to improve how the business manages its products, inventory, and computer repair services while making information more accessible to customers.

The website allows customers to browse products, view prices and stock availability, and search or filter items by category before visiting the store. It also includes a service availability calendar, allowing customers to check when computer repair services are available and plan their visits accordingly.

For the business owner, the system provides a digital inventory management dashboard where products can be added, edited, removed, and updated as stock changes. This helps replace manual inventory tracking with a more organized and accessible digital system.

Overall, the project aims to streamline business operations, improve inventory accuracy, reduce unnecessary customer visits, and provide a more convenient shopping and service experience through a user-friendly web platform.

ALAGAD: BukSU Campus Navigation and Assistant

My contribution
Prototyping, UI/UX Design, and Documentation
Description

ALAGAD is a campus navigation and information assistance system designed for Bukidnon State University (BukSU). Available through kiosk and mobile interfaces, it helps students, faculty, staff, and visitors locate campus buildings, offices, rooms, and facilities using an interactive digital map and route guidance.

Its AI-powered campus assistant supports questions in English, Tagalog, and Cebuano about service requirements, procedures, office locations, personnel assignments, and frequently asked questions. By combining navigation and access to campus information, ALAGAD aims to make finding destinations and understanding university services easier and more convenient.
